purpose: A single-path helper that formats a lane's status line for the swarm meter.

acceptance.then: apps/mobile/src/build/StatusEcho.ts's formatter produces a one-line, human-readable string

non_goals: Does not compute the lane's state, only renders an already-computed one

guarantees.claim: the formatter never throws on a well-typed LaneStatus

derivation.invariant: formatStatusEcho is a total function over the closed LaneStatus union

guarantees.label: kills_structural

alternatives.option: reuse the swarm console's own Rust-side status renderer via an FFI call
alternatives.why_killed: this module runs client-side in Metro/RN, which cannot call into the fleet Rust binary
alternatives.revive_trigger: the client ever gains a native bridge to fleet's binary

failure_story.trigger: a LaneStatus variant is added upstream without updating this formatter's switch
failure_story.blast_radius: the new state renders as an empty or garbled line in the swarm meter, confusing whoever is watching it
failure_story.fail_safe: a TypeScript exhaustiveness check on the switch fails the build the moment a variant is unhandled
